doc: A built road cell (design/planner.md, Roads): its paving and edge pieces, centred on the cell, with moving parts as bones (awnings sway, lamps flicker), its flow, collision, and guides for the viewer (its neighbours, its flow, its half, its fence edges).

fields.name: flow
fields.doc: Which edges a walker or cart passes through: bit d for edge d (its road and gate neighbours, less any its half takes).

fields.name: guide_lines
fields.doc: For the viewer only: line segments as pairs of points: each neighbour's outline coloured by what it is, arrows along the flow, the half's cut, and fence edges.

fields.name: guide_colors
fields.doc: Each guide segment's colour, packed RGBA.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The moving parts, animated by house_animate_v1.

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: stalls, carts, posts, crates, a bridge deck.
